verdict.rationale: E2B is built entirely around an SDK/API (Python/JS) for creating, controlling, and persisting sandboxes, with extensive documented methods (create, runCode, files, commands.run, setTimeout, metrics) plus a CLI and self-hosting option, making it inherently AI-native and API-driven. No formal OpenAPI spec was found (404s), but the SDK-level documented API surface is extensive and consistent across docs and GitHub.
